newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan construction shares down on debt report.
newsitem.headline: Japan construction shares down on debt report.

text.p: Shares in Japan's construction sector lost ground on Tuesday morning after a newspaper report said the sector is still burdened with heavy debts.
At 0118 GMT, shares in Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd were down seven yen or 3.66 percent at 184 yen, making it the 10th largest percentage loser on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Sato Kogyo Co Ltd was down three yen at 250 yen, after briefly dipping to a new low for the financial year to March 1997. Haseko Corp was down one yen at 203 yen, matching its low for the financial year.
At 0120 GMT, Shimizu Corp was down 17 yen at 743 yen yen. Tobishima Corp was down two yen at 158 yen.

The Japanese financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday that debts guaranteed for other companies by 98 Japanese general contractors totaled 3.22 trillion yen at the end of September 1996, down only 3.4 percent from the end of March 1996. The story quoted a survey by private research company Teikoku Databank Ltd.
